content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Step 1. Purchase a high-quality pasta machine (1 hour)
Step 2. Master the art of shaping orecchiette by hand (4 hours)
Step 3. Practice making a 24-hour slow-simmered ragu (1 day)

Step 10. Write down your own modified family recipes (2 hours)

Step 45. Create a social media portfolio of your dishes (3 hours)
Step 46. Build a wood-fired outdoor oven (4 days)
Step 47. Practice knife skills on a mirepoix (1 hour)
Step 48. Locate a source for fresh truffles (2 hours)
Step 49. Learn to make a dark, rich veal stock (12 hours)
Step 50. Practice searing scallops to a golden brown (10 minutes)
Step 51. Learn to bake crusty ciabatta bread (6 hours)
Step 52. Take a workshop on curing your own guanciale (1 month)
Step 53. Study the science of gluten development (2 hours)
Step 54. Practice tossing dough without tearing it (1 hour)
Step 55. Interview a professional chef about kitchen management (1 hour)
Step 56. Research the harvest cycles of Italian olives (2 hours)
Step 57. Master the art of making a silky Béchamel sauce (30 minutes)
Step 58. Learn to calibrate your oven temperature (30 minutes)
Step 59. Practice making a vibrant basil pesto (20 minutes)
Step 60. Buy high-quality digital kitchen scales (15 minutes)
Step 61. Attend a wine pairing seminar (4 hours)
Step 62. Take a trip to a local farmers market for seasonal produce (2 hours)
Step 63. Research the history of pizza in Naples (2 hours)
Step 64. Learn to preserve lemons in salt (30 minutes)
Step 65. Practice making a balsamic glaze reduction (45 minutes)
Step 66. Learn to fillet a whole sea bass (40 minutes)
Step 67. Practice roasting garlic until caramelized (1 hour)
Step 68. Buy a set of copper core cookware (2 hours)
Step 69. Clean and sharpen all kitchen tools (2 hours)
Step 70. Cook a traditional Sunday Feast for your family (6 hours)
